summary.text: Sasha Ripley is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Senate, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent John Jagler.

paragraphs.text: Sasha Ripley earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Stevens Point, with additional education from Madison College and Marian College, and Ballotpedia lists her profession as educator.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in the 13th Senate District most of her adult life, was the Education Navigator for Sauk County until the position lost funding, and now teaches GED and HSED classes to adults.
Ripley advanced from the Democratic primary for Wisconsin State Senate District 13 on August 11, 2026.

In the survey, she said she supports fully funding public schools, lowering property taxes, a pause on building data centers until strict regulations are in place, and increasing the housing supply in rural areas.
